## Error codes (17)

Closed union — adding one is deliberate. See [ERROR_HANDLING.md](../ERROR_HANDLING.md).

| Code                         | Status | User-facing message                            |
| ---------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED`          | 400    | Some of the information provided is not valid. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED`            | 401    | Please sign in to continue.                    |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`        | 401    | Invalid email or password.                     |
| `INVALID_CODE`               | 400    | Invalid or expired verification code.          |
| `EXPIRED_CODE`               | 400    | The verification code has expired.             |
| `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`          | 429    | Too many attempts. Please try again later.     |
| `FORBIDDEN`                  | 403    | You do not have access to this.                |
| `WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND`        | 404    | That workspace could not be found.             |
| `WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED`    | 403    | You do not have access to this workspace.      |
| `WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_MISSING`  | 500    | Something went wrong. Please try again.        |
| `WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_CONFLICT` | 500    | Something went wrong. Please try again.        |
| `NOT_FOUND`                  | 404    | That item could not be found.                  |
| `CONFLICT`                   | 409    | That change conflicts with the current state.  |
| `RATE_LIMITED`               | 429    | Too many requests. Please slow down.           |
| `DB_QUERY_FAILED`            | 500    | Something went wrong. Please try again.        |
| `UPSTREAM_FAILED`            | 502    | A service we depend on is unavailable.         |
| `INTERNAL`                   | 500    | Something went wrong. Please try again.        |

## Environment (7)

Validated at boot in `@shared/config/env`; a bad value crashes the process.

| Variable                        | Required | Rule                                                                   |
| ------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NODE_ENV`                      | no       | `z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development')` |
| `DATABASE_URL`                  | yes      | `z.string().url()`                                                     |
| `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL`        | no       | `z.string().url().optional()`                                          |
| `WORKSPACE_RESOLUTION_STRATEGY` | no       | `z.enum(['subdomain', 'path', 'header']).default('subdomain')`         |
| `APP_BASE_DOMAIN`               | yes      | `z.string().min(1)`                                                    |
| `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`            | no       | `z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(10).default(1)`                    |
| `LOG_LEVEL`                     | no       | `z.enum(['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error']).default('info')`           |
